class.description: DOD NOTE: AccessibilityLivePreviewCard renders an immediate-mode split preview card for `GameplayAccessibilityOption` so players can verify visual, color-vision, entity-outline, high-contrast UI, and closed-caption settings before applying them. It simulates on the CPU: 1. Daltonization / Color Vision Deficiency transforms (`CVD_PROTANOPIA`, `CVD_DEUTERANOPIA`, `CVD_TRITANOPIA`, `CVD_ACHROMATOPSIA`) blended by `color_vision_strength`, plus `brightness_adjustment`, `contrast_adjustment`, and `saturation_adjustment`. 2. 3D Entity Silhouette Badges (Enemy `RedRobot`, Interactable, and Hazard) with `high_contrast_entity_outlines` and `enemy_highlight_color` / `interactable_highlight_color` / `hazard_highlight_color`. 3. Live Closed-Caption Overlay Box previewing `closed_captions_enabled`, `caption_text_scale`, `caption_background_opacity`, and `caption_speaker_labels`. Part of IdeamGames (game agents, players, rules, scoring, and match orchestration).
